question: Does integrating a declared spatially varying source-cover field change matched whole-place-excluded pollen predictions relative to direct pollen IDW and homogeneous centre-cover forwarding?

cores.centre_authority: Literal native EPSG:4326 site Point; collection-unit GPS is null.
Literal native EPSG:4326 site Point; collection-unit GPS is null. The separate inventory point is 2.5264km away; no coordinate correction or physical identity resolution is asserted.

Existing qualified Nordic-cohort analysis centroid of the native EPSG:4326 site Polygon; not a source GPS measurement. Collection-unit GPS is null. SOLSOE81 shares this physical place and is excluded from every SOLSOE83 target fold. The inherited implementation used binary64 planar longitude/latitude shoelace arithmetic, not a geodesic centroid; this study fixes its saved qualified centroid rather than recomputing or correcting it.

population.exposure: All sources, windows and outcomes were exposed development material. No untouched confirmation or independent vegetation benchmark is created.

cohort_rule: Freeze the inherited complete source panels BEFORE projection: BOKE three taxa, BUS two taxa and SOLSOE83 six taxa, all explicit nonnegative integer NISP with positive source/projected totals. This is a fixed comparison subset, not all possible two-taxon-eligible samples. Keep all native samples, exclusions and omitted mass; no absent taxon is filled with zero. Named native point ages are fixed; AD1950 is a declared interpretation and no CE conversion or age-uncertainty propagation is performed.

field.coordinate_frame: Per target, WGS84 azimuthal-equidistant projection centred on its declared analysis point, metres. Source distances within the field are planar Euclidean distances in that frame, not independently surveyed vegetation distances.
field.anchor_order: Other two core IDs in lexical order; reject duplicate physical places and exclude the complete target place.
field.anchor_inversion: For source s, c_s=closure(n_s/(K_s*PPE)); K_s is its OWN homogeneous receiver response. Source regional summaries become point anchors by an explicit two-stage approximation; this does not jointly fit a self-consistent landscape to source observations.
field.interpolation: Inverse squared Euclidean distance, normalized over the two training anchors; the continuous limiting value at an exact anchor equals its own composition. No smoothing length or score-dependent weight is selected.
field.landscape_posture: The interpolated composition field is a declared hypothesis, not measured vegetation. No plants on the receiving basin, anisotropy, shoreline change or separate regional background is modeled.

physical.inner_radius_rule: Equal to each target receiving radius
physical.receiver: Uniform circular disk at the inherited static metadata radius
physical.source_geometry_authority: LandClimII metadata workbook rows977/978/95 and readme siteradius definition in metres. These are static circular hypotheses, not authenticated historical shorelines. BOKE modern1.5/1.6ha and BUS0.3/3ha/coordinate disagreements remain separate source facts.
physical.transport_posture: Existing stationary isotropic GPM displacement convention; coefficient0.12 is empirical, not SI diffusivity. PPE transfer is literal-label conditional transfer, with the same published means/FSP for every place. No PPE, count, site-selection or field uncertainty law is estimated.

geometry_qualification.annulus_edges: Fixed logarithmic spacing from receiver radius to100km; no target-driven refinement.
refusals: nonpositive coefficient with positive homogeneous response
primary coefficient outside independent annular step bracket beyond declared numerical tolerance
geometry_qualification.enclosure_posture: Independent spatial-discretization step brackets are conditional on computed homogeneous ring factors. Report bracket widths and nonrigorous quadrature estimates separately. Their width does not certify the primary1e-9 setting or bound the true integral rigorously.
geometry_qualification.propagation: Freeze coefficient and normalized prediction ranges before scoring. Propagate conservative two-component positive-normalization ranges through all metrics; these are numerical qualification diagnostics conditional on saved source anchors/nuisance factors, not ecological confidence intervals. The same geometry coefficients are reused across six windows; sums of per-context endpoint scores give conservative aggregate enclosures, not one jointly attaining model. Independent component normalization can enlarge the attainable set; individual probability/score endpoints are conservative and need not arise from one compatible physical coefficient vector.
geometry_qualification.homogeneous_baseline: Compute six standalone old circular_receiver_annulus responses independently of the six new weighted spatial calls. Failure of weighted coefficients or step brackets refuses only spatial predictions; homogeneous baseline availability follows its own receiver responses.
geometry_qualification.memory_posture: Geometry memory is a planning estimate; the overall 768MiB posthoc peak RSS budget governs the owned process. No in-run memory cap is claimed.

family_definitions.direct_pollen_idw: IDW at the target centre of the two source projected pollen fractions.
family_definitions.centre_cover_idw_forward: Same centre IDW of the two inverse source-cover anchors, then target homogeneousK*PPE forwarding and closure.
family_definitions.spatial_cover_idw_forward: For taxon i, close PPE_i*sum_s(B_target,i,s*c_s,i), where B integrates the SAME IDW field over the target land annulus and receiving disk.

metrics.definitions: MAE=mean_i abs(pred_i-obs_i); TV=0.5*sum_i abs(pred_i-obs_i); these coincide for two-component closure. Reuse maintained Hellinger stable arithmetic: sqrt(sum_i(sqrt(pred_i)-sqrt(obs_i))^2/2). All three families and all metrics remain reported; no result-driven winner or metric selection.
metrics.aggregation: Equal mean over the six windows within each physical target, then equal mean across three places. No pooled-count score or source-effort weighting.
metrics.incomplete_population: Retain all18contexts and54family outcomes. Complete-cohort family/matched comparison summaries refuse if any required prediction/score is missing; retain per-context successes/refusals without renormalizing the primary cohort.
metrics.resolution: Retain point scores and propagated conservative numerical ranges. Score differences that those ranges do not separate remain numerically unresolved; printed digits do not establish finer accuracy.

prediction_boundary: The callable predictor takes only two training anchor count panels and target geometry/window identity. It never receives matching target counts. Parse/validate source inputs as needed, preserving prior exposure; there is no global unread-target claim. Persist/close prediction identities, coefficient certificates and numerical prediction ranges for all18contexts before a separate scorer receives target outcomes. Scorer reads that frozen prediction file and records its identity.
rights: Neotoma/EPD current CC BY4.0 policy with Neotoma, EPD, original investigators and all native dataset DOI strings retained. Public LandClim parameter/metadata source PANGAEA.937075 is CC BY4.0. Historical Rootsi access markers/private author copies are not count inputs. Reuse retained qualified publication metadata and policy bytes; original April HTTP wire custody is not recovered and no current value-parity claim is inferred from these old normalized response bodies.
